meta.promptText: India mein 2000 rupees ke andar men ke liye konse brand ki jeans kharidni chahiye?

response.text:
Haan — **₹2,000 ke andar** men’s jeans ke liye meri priority ye rahegi:

1. **Pepe Jeans — Best overall** ⭐  
   Sale mein ₹1,449–₹1,999 ke aas-paas achhi straight/slim-fit jeans mil rahi hain. Brand quality aur look dono strong hain. [www.pepejeans.in](https://www.pepejeans.in/men/jeans?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   
   ### [Pepe Jeans Men's Holborne Mid Rise Straight Jeans]()
*₹1,359.15*

2. **Lee — Best for comfort & quality**  
   ₹1,300–₹1,500 range mein bhi options mil rahe hain. Agar daily wear ke liye chahiye, Lee ka stretch denim achha choice hai. [www.magicpin.in](https://www.magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/top-jeans-brands-in-india-men?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
   
   ### [Lee Men's Rodeo Straight Fit Stretchable Jeans]()
*₹1,450*

3. **Levi's — Best brand, agar sale mil jaye**  
   Levi's ke kuch 511/512/513 models abhi ₹1,679–₹1,970 tak listed hain, isliye ₹2,000 budget mein sale ke time Levi's lena **bahut achha deal** hai. [levi.in](https://levi.in/collections/men-jeans?filter.v.availability=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. **Spykar — Best Indian/value option**  
   ₹1,500–₹2,000 ke budget mein achhe stretch/tapered options milte hain. [magicpin.in](https://magicpin.in/blog/category/fashion/top-jeans-brands-in-india-men?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

5. **Roadster / Highlander — Best budget**  
   Agar ₹700–₹1,200 mein jeans chahiye, ye dono value-for-money hain. Lekin ₹2,000 pura spend karna ho to main **Pepe, Lee ya Levi's** ko prefer karunga.

### Meri ranking:
**Pepe Jeans > Lee > Levi's (sale) > Spykar > Roadster/Highlander**

Agar tum mujhe **apni age, height, waist size aur body type (patla/normal/healthy)** bata do, main ₹2,000 ke andar **3 exact jeans (fit + colour + current price)** recommend kar sakta hoon.
